notes:
Summary: Enterprise evaluation for Dedicated capacity. Primary workload = low-latency fraud scoring + reranking for transaction pipeline; secondary = internal support chat and embeddings for fast vector lookups.

Workload details (from workshop):
- Steady-state baseline: ~60 QPS of scoring requests (model: open-variant mix; avg response tokens 12-24).
- Peak bursts: up to 420 QPS sustained for 3-5 minutes (batch job and traffic bursts during promos).
- Embedding throughput: ~250 requests/sec during nightly enrichment windows (avg 1536-dim vectors).
- Token/sec estimate: steady-state ~1.2k tokens/sec total; peak ~8.5k tokens/sec across cluster.
- Latency targets: p95 < 200ms for scoring (critical path), p99 < 450ms acceptable; embeddings p95 < 100ms.
- SLO preference: hard latency SLOs for fraud scoring with automatic fallback to cheaper model variant on degradation.

Sizing ask / draft recommendation (SE notes):
- Initial reserved footprint: 4 x H100 (80GB) equivalent nodes for production steady-state; 2 additional burst nodes in autoscale pool for peak coverage — goal to meet p95 targets with headroom.
- KV cache expected to reduce repeat-token compute by ~18% (based on sample traces) — include prefix cache config in POC.
workshop_takeaways:
- Need clearer peak profile: business to provide 3 months of 1-minute-interval QPS traces.
- Confirm model family: customer using mix of Llama-3-Chat-13B (quantized) + proprietary reranker. Quantization impacts kernel choices.
- Request for SLA negotiation: 99.9% uptime target for Dedicated; penalty structure discussed but legal needs draft.
- Data residency: all inference logs must remain in customer VPC and 365-day retention on audit logs.
- KMS integration required; test vector for HSM flow to be scheduled.

poc_plan:
POC 6 weeks: Weeks 0-1 data ingest + traffic replay; Weeks 2-3 run throughput sweeps (steady vs burst); Week 4 validate latency SLOs at p95/p99; Week 5 cost/tuning (quant, batching); Week 6 handoff + decision. Deliverables: load report, kernel/quant profile, recommended reserved capacity and forecasted cost.
POC acceptance criteria: p95 latency < 225ms for scoring at steady-state and < 500ms at peak with fallback behavior documented.
quote_notes: Preliminary pricing discussed in pricing deck v2. Draft ARR estimate $250k–$750k depending on commit. AE requested Dedicated reserved vs committed + burst pricing comparison for legal. Include yearly capacity audit clause.
